name: agentic-ds-kit

tools.name: list_components
tools.description: List every UI component in this install, blocks included. Default summary rows: id, code name, kind (component, or block for a larger composition such as AgentOverview), level (atom, molecule, organism or block) and the first sentence of its purpose. detail full adds the category and the whole purpose line. Filter with kind and/or level; page with limit and offset (page.next). Reuse the biggest level that fits before building from smaller ones. Use get_component for props and rules.

detail.description: summary (short rows) or full (every field). Default summary.

level.description: Only one level: atom, molecule, organism, block. Patterns are level template; use list_patterns.

limit.description: Page size, 1-500. Omit for all rows.

offset.description: Rows to skip. Use page.next from the previous answer.

tools.name: get_component
tools.description: Get one component by code name or contract id (Button or button). Returns its kind and level, props, enum variants, must and doNot rules, the tokens the contract lists, an import line, and a usage example from the contract snippet.

name.description: Component code name or contract id, such as Button or button.

tools.name: search_components
tools.description: Find components whose name, purpose, or contract keywords match. Keywords are the contract useWhen, doNotUseWhen, and doNot lines. Every word must match. Case-insensitive. Rows include kind and level.

query.description: Words to match, such as "date" or "kpi".

tools.name: get_tokens
tools.description: Semantic tokens from this install. Default summary rows: CSS variable name, group and value (color adds the dark value). detail full adds the usage note, useWhen and doNot from tokens/usage.json. Groups: color, type, space, radius, grid; omit group for all five. Page with limit and offset (page.next). Primitive --color-* ramps are not included.

group.description: color, type, space, radius, or grid. Omit for all five.

detail.description: summary (short rows) or full (every field). Default summary.

limit.description: Page size, 1-500. Omit for all rows.

offset.description: Rows to skip. Use page.next from the previous answer.

tools.name: list_patterns
tools.description: List copy-in screen patterns. Each entry has an id, its level (always template, the biggest level), a one-line description, and the npx agentic-ds-kit add command that copies it into an app.

tools.name: get_pattern
tools.description: Get one pattern by id (dashboard or app-shell). Returns its level (template), the description, the npx agentic-ds-kit add command, and the contract must and defaults.

id.description: Pattern id, such as dashboard or app-shell.

tools.name: get_rules
tools.description: Return this install's AGENTS.md, including the page-layout rule for layout classes and --grid-* tokens. This is the rule text agents should follow.

tools.name: questions
tools.description: Build the same closed option list as `npx agentic-ds-kit questions` from this install's contracts. Pass no arguments for the full list. Options match the CLI: only, group (component or pattern), overlay (the JSON object, not a file path), none, useWhen, notWhen, askStyle (part or strict), enums (own, all, or none). detail summary returns only id, label and kind per option (no enums); limit and offset page the options (page.next).

overlay.description: Overlay object with only, composites, options, and/or drop. Same shape as the questions --overlay file.

detail.description: full (the CLI JSON) or summary (id, label, kind). Default full.

limit.description: Page size, 1-500. Omit for all rows.

offset.description: Rows to skip. Use page.next from the previous answer.

tools.name: review_ui
tools.description: Check UI code against this install's contracts and tokens, the same as `npx agentic-ds-kit review`. Pass path (a file or folder, relative to the folder the server runs in), or code plus filename to check a draft that is not saved yet (filename picks the rules and names the file, such as app/page.tsx). Returns findings (id, rule, severity, file, line, contractId, message, fix), the error and warning counts, and score (the contract fit score, 0-100, as from `review --score`). Rules: raw-value, wrong-use, outside-kit (errors); rebuild, pattern-fits (warnings). Fix every error before you finish.

path.description: File or folder to review, such as app or app/page.tsx.

code.description: Source text of a draft. Needs filename.

filename.description: Name for the draft, such as app/page.tsx. Needs code.

tools.name: inspect_ui
tools.description: List the kit pieces on a rendered page, the same as `npx agentic-ds-kit inspect`. Kit components write data-nistha="<id>" on their root when the app runs with NEXT_PUBLIC_NISTHA_INSPECT=1 (never in production builds). Pass url (an http(s) page, read as the HTML the server sends, without a browser), or html plus name for markup you already have, such as a saved page. Returns the pieces grouped by level (biggest first) with counts, ids not in this kit's index, landmark counts (main, h1) and problems: no-main, multiple-main, no-h1 (errors). With no markers, inspectMode is false and note says inspect mode may be off.

url.description: Page to read, such as http://localhost:3000/settings.

html.description: Page markup to read instead of a url. Needs name.

name.description: Name for the html in the result, such as settings.html. Needs html.

instructions: Read-only catalog of the agentic-ds-kit install this process was started from. Use these tools for components, tokens, patterns, kit rules, the questions option list, review_ui to check UI code, and inspect_ui to list the kit pieces on a rendered page. Answers come from that install's files. Do not invent a component or token the tools do not return.
